title: Self-sufficient killing of malignant tumors by an engineered cancer-selective gene circuit.
authors: Liu, Qi; Xiong, Qiqi; Xie, Guanglei; Chen, Qidi; Yang, Shujie; Wu, Yuhang; Zhao, Liuqi; Gao, Ting; Qiu, Xinyuan; Jiang, Jian; Wang, Xi; Shao, Jiawei; Xie, Mingqi; Ying, Songmin
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习设计癌症选择性启动子识别ETS转录因子异常，但核心是基因治疗而非蛋白-DNA互作建模，仅间接涉及TF-DNA结合，方法为随机森林而非结构或动力学模拟。
abstract: Gene therapies that selectively eliminate tumor cells within a heterogenous population remain an elusive goal in oncology, largely due to the difficulty to achieve cancer specificity by strict definition. Here, we engineer a therapeutic gene circuit capable of identifying cells that harbor oncogenic gain-of-function aberrations in E26 transformation-specific (ETS) transcription factors. Using a machine learning-guided random forest framework, we develop a cancer-selective promoter P(ETS *) that only activates during ETS overexpression and/or gene fusion events, while remaining inactive under physiological RAF-MEK-ERK signaling or in rapidly proliferating healthy tissues. When delivered using adenoviral vectors, P(ETS *) enables tumor-restricted viral replication in vivo as well as long-lasting tumor suppression and complete survival of treated mice. Specifically, intratracheal delivery of P(ETS *)-driven adenoviruses achieves sustained control of metastatic lung tumors for over 140 days. This work overcomes key barriers of synthetic biology and oncolytic virotherapy and could open up important avenues for future cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 在异质性群体中选择性消除肿瘤细胞的基因疗法，在肿瘤学中仍是一个难以实现的目标，主要因为难以严格定义癌症特异性。在此，我们设计了一种治疗性基因回路，能够识别携带E26转化特异性（ETS）转录因子致癌性功能获得性畸变的细胞。利用机器学习引导的随机森林框架，我们开发了一种癌症选择性启动子P(ETS *)，该启动子仅在ETS过表达和/或基因融合事件中激活，而在生理性RAF-MEK-ERK信号传导或快速增殖的健康组织中保持失活。当通过腺病毒载体递送时，P(ETS *)能够在体内实现肿瘤限制性病毒复制，以及持久的肿瘤抑制和治疗小鼠的完全存活。具体而言，气管内递送P(ETS *)驱动的腺病毒，对转移性肺肿瘤实现了超过140天的持续控制。这项工作克服了合成生物学和溶瘤病毒疗法的关键障碍，可能为未来癌症治疗开辟重要途径。
